import json

# Convert to JSON-serializable format

for k, v in sd.items():
    if hasattr(v, 'tolist'):
        d[k] = v.tolist()
    else:
        d[k] = v

# Save to weights.json
with open('weights.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(d, f)

print("weights.json created successfully")
print("Keys:", list(d.keys()))
